items.name: Export to Banner Award Extraction v0.2.0
items.description: Uploads a fully-executed federal award document and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Export to Banner Reference Summary covering the seven sections needed to populate VERAS's Export to Banner form: award identification, dates & performance period, sponsor information, budget summary, billing & payment, reporting & compliance, and special terms & FOI items. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction consolidation.md conventions, including the `[DISCREPANCY - ...]` flag syntax.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: University of Idaho Office of Sponsored Programs
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary KB — contains UI institutional Banner conventions and FOI text-field formatting standards. For agency- specific terms, swap in NSF PAPPG / NIH GPS / DOE / DOD / FAR. When the operator does not attach a KB, the extraction falls back to reading just the uploaded award document.

data.name: extract-award-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting award identification fields from a
fully-executed federal award document. You receive the
uploaded document AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Quote identifiers verbatim. Use null when
absent.

Emit a JSON object with: award_number (FAIN), project_title,
pi_name, award_type (one of "Grant", "Cooperative Agreement",
"Contract", "Subcontract"), is_pass_through (boolean),
prime_sponsor_name (STRING, populated only when is_pass_through
is true), cfda_number (STRING in XX.XXX format),
naics_code (STRING), federal_agency_name (STRING),
action_type (STRING — "New", "Continuation", "Amendment").

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-dates-and-performance
data.prompt:
You are extracting date fields and performance period from a
federal award document. You receive the uploaded document AND
any KB chunks.

Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous; preserve the
document's stated form otherwise. Use null when absent.

Emit a JSON object with: award_start_date, award_end_date,
performance_period_start, performance_period_end (all
STRINGS), budget_periods (JSON ARRAY of {period_number,
start_date, end_date, amount}), is_multi_year (BOOLEAN or
null).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-sponsor-and-entity
data.prompt:
You are extracting sponsor and entity classification from a
federal award document.

Be 100% accurate.

Emit a JSON object with: sponsor_name (STRING, full legal
name), sponsor_entity_type (one of "Federal", "State Government",
"Non-Profit", "Private Industry", "Foundation", "University",
"Other"), classification_evidence (STRING — short note on how
the entity type was determined), federal_agency_hierarchy
(STRING), sponsor_address (STRING), sponsor_uei (STRING —
12-char alphanumeric), awardee_organization (STRING),
awardee_uei (STRING), grants_officer_name (STRING),
program_officer_name (STRING).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-budget-and-financial
data.prompt:
You are extracting budget and financial terms from a federal
award document.

Be 100% accurate. Monetary fields preserve $X,XXX.XX format
verbatim. Use null when absent.

Emit a JSON object with: total_award_amount (STRING),
total_anticipated_amount (STRING or null),
budget_categories (JSON ARRAY of {category, approved_amount}),
total_direct_costs (STRING), total_indirect_costs (STRING),
fa_rate (STRING — e.g., "47.5%"), fa_rate_base (one of
"MTDC", "TDC", "Salary & Wages", "Other", or null),
fa_status (one of "Full Rate", "Reduced", "Waived", or null),
is_fa_waived (BOOLEAN or null), cost_share_amount (STRING or
null), cost_share_type (STRING or null), program_income
(STRING or null).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-billing-and-payment
data.prompt:
You are extracting billing and payment terms from a federal
award document.

Emit a JSON object with: billing_type (one of "Cost Reimbursement",
"Fixed Price", "Letter of Credit", "Milestone"), billing_frequency
(STRING), billing_address (STRING), invoice_email (STRING),
pms_loc_code (STRING), payment_terms (STRING),
invoice_requirements (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
final_invoice_deadline (STRING), billing_contact (STRING).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-reporting-and-special
data.prompt:
You are extracting reporting requirements and special terms
from a federal award document.

Emit a JSON object with: reporting_requirements (JSON ARRAY
of {report_type, frequency, due_date_or_timing, submission_method}),
record_retention_period (STRING),
carry_forward_policy (STRING),
prior_approval_requirements (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
special_terms (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS — terms beyond standard
federal requirements; publication restrictions; IP/data
provisions; non-standard terms),
closeout_requirements (STRING),
governing_regulations (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS — 2 CFR 200,
RTCs, agency-specific cited regs).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: export-to-banner-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Export to Banner
Award Extraction workflow. You receive SIX JSON fragments
from the previous step.

Cross-validate the fragments. When values contradict, do
NOT alter them — flag with
`[DISCREPANCY - Task X states ___ while Task Y states ___]`
in the appropriate section.

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Export to Banner
Reference Summary. Mirrors source consolidation.md exactly.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Export to Banner Reference Summary: <award_number>

### SECTION 1: AWARD IDENTIFICATION

- **Award Number / FAIN:** <award_number>
- **CFDA Number:** <cfda_number or "Not specified">
- **NAICS Code:** <naics_code or "Not specified">
- **Full Project Title:** <project_title>
- **Principal Investigator:** <pi_name>
- **Award Type:** <award_type>
- **Action Type:** <action_type or "Not specified">
- **Federal Awarding Agency:** <federal_agency_name>
- **Federal Agency Hierarchy:** <federal_agency_hierarchy or "Not specified">
- **Pass-Through Status:** <"Direct Award" if !is_pass_through else "Pass-Through from " + prime_sponsor_name>

---

### SECTION 2: DATES & PERFORMANCE PERIOD

| Field | Date |
|---|---|
| Award Start Date | <award_start_date> |
| Award End Date | <award_end_date> |
| Performance Period Start | <performance_period_start> |
| Performance Period End | <performance_period_end> |

Note: <"Single-period award" if !is_multi_year else "Multi-year incremental award with N periods">

When budget_periods is non-empty, render a sub-table:

| Period | Start | End | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|

---

### SECTION 3: SPONSOR INFORMATION

- **Sponsor Legal Name:** <sponsor_name>
- **Sponsor Entity Type:** <sponsor_entity_type>
- **Classification Evidence:** <classification_evidence or "Per Federal Agency designation">
- **Sponsor Address:** <sponsor_address or "Not specified">
- **Sponsor UEI:** <sponsor_uei or "Not specified">
- **Awardee Organization:** <awardee_organization>
- **Awardee UEI:** <awardee_uei or "Not specified">
- **Grants Officer:** <grants_officer_name or "Not specified">
- **Program Officer:** <program_officer_name or "Not specified">

---

### SECTION 4: BUDGET SUMMARY

| Category | Amount |
|---|---|

One row per budget_categories entry, ending with:
| **Total Direct Costs** | **<total_direct_costs>** |
| **Total Indirect Costs** | **<total_indirect_costs>** |
| **Total Award Amount** | **<total_award_amount>** |

Followed by:

- **F&A Rate and Base:** <fa_rate> <fa_rate_base>
- **F&A Status:** <fa_status or "Full Rate">
- **Cost Sharing:** <cost_share_amount or "None required"> (<cost_share_type or "—">)

---

### SECTION 5: BILLING & PAYMENT

- **Billing Type:** <billing_type>
- **Billing Frequency:** <billing_frequency or "Not specified">
- **Invoice Submission:** <billing_address or "Not specified"> (<invoice_email or "no email">)
- **PMS / LOC Code:** <pms_loc_code or "Not specified">
- **Final Invoice Deadline:** <final_invoice_deadline or "Not specified">
- **Payment Terms:** <payment_terms or "Not specified">

**Required Invoice Elements:**
- <bulleted list from invoice_requirements, or "Not specified">

---

### SECTION 6: REPORTING & COMPLIANCE

**Required Reports:**

| Type | Frequency | Due Date |
|---|---|---|

One row per reporting_requirements entry.

- **Record Retention Period:** <record_retention_period or "3 years per 2 CFR 200.334">
- **Carry-Forward Policy:** <carry_forward_policy or "Standard federal default">

**Key Prior Approval Requirements:**
- <bulleted list from prior_approval_requirements>

**Governing Regulations:**
- <bulleted list from governing_regulations>

---

### SECTION 7: SPECIAL TERMS & FOI ITEMS

Banner FOI text fields — copy these into Banner FOI:

- <bulleted list from special_terms>
- **Closeout Requirements:** <closeout_requirements or "Standard federal closeout">

---

### FINAL VERIFICATION CHECKLIST

- [ ] All monetary amounts are exact (no rounding)
- [ ] All dates are in their original format
- [ ] Award number matches across all sections
- [ ] No information was lost during consolidation
- [ ] "Not specified in the document" preserved where appropriate
- [ ] No discrepancies remain unresolved (or all are flagged)

## Rendering rules

- Bold every label.
- Reference document — concise and actionable, not narrative.
- Preserve monetary and date formats verbatim.
- Use `[DISCREPANCY - Task X states ___ while Task Y states ___]`
  for any cross-task contradiction.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE
  into prose / table.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.description: Verify award_start_date < award_end_date and performance_period_start <= award_start_date.

validation_plan.description: Verify monetary amounts preserve the source document's currency formatting verbatim.

validation_plan.description: Verify UEIs follow the 12-character alphanumeric format when present.
